stop_reason: GSE242861 contains only in-vitro primary myotubes transfected with miR-30a/miR-30c mimics or scramble (6 donors x 3 treatments). There is no exercise, sedentary/trained, or pre/post-exercise factor, so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified. The paper's exercise analysis uses in-vivo TaqMan miRNA arrays (S5.8.p1, S5.9.3.p1) that are not deposited in this series.
